welcome.title: Learn in conversation.
welcome.lede: Learn a new language through quick, real conversations.

login.title: Log in
login.lede: Use the email and password for your Zipdeck account.

register.title: Continue with email
register.lede: This is the same account as Zipdeck.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.sent: A new code is on its way.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.start: Choose a scene to start the first one.

grades.practicingHint: You still want to practice this scene.
grades.learnedHint: You can play this scene without help.

scenes.title: Choose a scene
scenes.lede: Pick a place. The conversation starts there.
scenes.cafeLine: Order something and talk at the counter.
scenes.airportLine: Check in, ask about a bag, find the gate.
scenes.doctorLine: Say what hurts and answer a few questions.
scenes.hotelLine: Check in and ask for the room you want.
scenes.pharmacyLine: Ask for something when you do not know the name.
scenes.interviewLine: Introduce yourself and ask about the work.
scenes.customPlaceholder: Talking about last night's football match with a friend

practice.gradeWhole: {{title}}. Grade the whole scene, not each line.
practice.note: Fully learned is the one that stays with you. A later conversation can bring those words back. Still practicing keeps the scene in the list you are working through.
practice.turn: Turn {{current}} of {{total}}. You play the {{role}}. {{native}} is the meaning; {{target}} is the line to say.
practice.voiceUnsupported: No voice is installed for this language.

listen.title: Listen
listen.lede: Hear both sides of a conversation, with a pause before the next line.
listen.plays: Plays the line, then the meaning.
listen.end: That’s the end of the scene.
listen.sleepHint: Listening stops when this time is up.
listen.blocked: Tap play to start the audio.

me.proOn: Zipdeck Pro is on for this account.
me.proOff: This account does not have Zipdeck Pro yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Appearance, language, and listening are saved on your account.
settings.languageHint: This language is used in ZipCONVO and on your Zipdeck account.
settings.listeningHint: These choices are used when a conversation plays.

cards.title: Flashcards
cards.makeLead: Make a deck from the lines in this conversation.
cards.makeExplain: One card for each line. {{native}} is the front. {{target}} is the back.
cards.noneDue: Nothing is due in this deck right now.
cards.needBoth: Enter a front and a back.
cards.emptyDeck: This deck has no cards yet.
cards.noLines: This conversation has no lines to turn into cards.
cards.gone: This deck is no longer available.

errors.emailExists: An account with that email already exists
errors.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.aiBusy: The AI is busy right now. You were not charged. Try again in a minute.
errors.studioNoConversation: The AI did not create a conversation. You were not charged.
errors.studioCustomPrompt: Keep the extra details under 240 characters
errors.timedOut: Timed out waiting for the conversation
errors.notWritten: The conversation could not be written
errors.noLines: This conversation has no lines to turn into cards
errors.deckNotFound: This deck is no longer available.
errors.deckNameTaken: You already have a deck with that name
